channel.title: Calcitax Advisors News
channel.description: Canadian tax, accounting and finance news in plain language.

item.title: Moved from Canada to India this year? Your Canadian tax to-do list
item.description: Leaving Canada for India in 2026? Here's what to file with the CRA: your final return, departure tax forms, and what happens to your accounts and benefits.

item.title: New to Canada in 2026? Your first-year tax and benefits checklist
item.description: Moved to Canada this year? How to apply for benefits now, file your first return by April 30, 2027, and handle property and income from abroad.

item.title: 2027 CPP and EI numbers: lower base CPP rate, higher earnings ceilings
item.description: CPP's base rate drops to 4.75% each for workers and employers on January 1, 2027, while the CPP and EI earnings ceilings rise. Here's what changes.

item.title: CRA's new pre-filled tax return: set up your account by October 31
item.description: About one million Canadians will be invited to file a pre-filled 2026 return in March 2027. To qualify, your CRA account must be set up by October 31, 2026.

item.title: Bank of Canada raises its rate to 2.5%: what it means for you
item.description: The Bank of Canada raised its policy rate on October 28, 2026, its first increase since 2023, citing higher energy prices and stubborn inflation.

item.title: CRA updates for small businesses: online debt payments, Apple Pay and more
item.description: Business owners can now manage payroll, GST/HST and corporate tax debts online, and pay the CRA with Apple Pay or Google Pay. Here's what's new this fall.
